trajectory.result: PResults pseudotime and branch_probs, including standard probability truncation below 0.01; no additional pseudotime normalization
trajectory.waypoints: 500 requested samples, not a required final cardinality after Palantir unions and deduplication

differential_expression.counts: original raw counts for all 16106 genes
differential_expression.cell_selection: drop only zero combined DC/Ery probability; renormalize retained two weights row-wise
differential_expression.pseudotime: same Palantir pseudotime in both lineage columns, aligned by barcode
differential_expression.offset: log(colSums(raw_counts_retained_cells) * edgeR::calcNormFactors(raw_counts_retained_cells, method='TMM')); compute using all genes; no fallback
differential_expression.SCE_dispatch: assemble SingleCellExperiment; pass its raw-count assay with explicit pseudotime/cellWeights to fitGAM (the SCE-input method assumes slingshot)
differential_expression.batching: allowed with complete-count shared TMM offset, seed 27 reset immediately before every fitGAM call, identical cells/lineage assignments/knots/design; fit all genes exactly once
differential_expression.failed_tests: effective p=1 when tradeSeq converged flag is not TRUE, coefficients/covariance are nonfinite, or test p-value is nonfinite; record failures; never skip a batch after a batch-level exception

p_adjust.scope: all tested genes together, never per batch

differential_expression.selection: finite padj < 0.05; no separate absolute logFC or fcMedian filter
